answer: Glacier admission gate: each epoch the network mints only as many sable admission tokens as its memory-hard puzzle allows, each bound to one identity's voyage through k co-signing checkpoints. The puzzle burns real RAM-hours, so a sybil farmer minting M false agents pays M times the hardware-time bill up front. Held at glacier pace, payback stretches past each identity's useful life: when M identities finally reach establishment, honest agents hold compounded reputation the farmer cannot buy, and the sunk compute is unrecoverable.
